messages:
Dana (Marketing): Quick kickoff 1: we need a compact 'Field Kit' for regulated customers: 1-page security + SLA summary, 2 slide benchmark callouts, 3 email subject lines, and a short webinar teaser. Target: ship to field next Tue. Who can pick what?

Sam (Growth): I can draft the email subjects + short AB copy. Want the emails to point to a 1-pager + request security review CTA.

Ivy (Product): I'll handle SLA summary + deploy-mode bullets (what we support and tradeoffs). Will include a short note on private control plane and on-prem packaging. ETA: Mon noon.

Omar (Eng): Will export two reproducible bench images (p95 latency and cost-per-1k). Also add short notes on test conditions. Link mock: https://drive.google.com/bench-exports

Dana (Marketing): For the one-pager, prioritize clarity: top-line claim, 4 bullets on controls, one small diagram of deploy modes, bottom CTA + lead routing.

Nina (Field): I'll provide 2 quick battle cards for AE handoff: "common questions" + "security red flags". Also want lead routing: if customer requests SOC2 + private deployment -> route to enterprise AE queue.

Jon (Design): Got it. I'll do an A4 single column layout and two slides (16:9) with light background. Any brand constraints beyond the usual?

Dana (Marketing): Keep brand kit, use security accent color, avoid customer screenshots. Also we need three email subject lines in different tones. Sam?

Sam (Growth): Drafts: ```
1) Secure, SLA-backed LLM inference for regulated apps
2) Meet your SLAs: deploy Redwood Inference privately or hosted
3) Start a security review & 2-week pilot for private deployments
```
Pick one, we'll AB test.

Ivy (Product): SLA snippet (draft): "Uptime: 99.95% (Dedicated). Latency SLOs: p95 targets published per model & profile. Response: 24/7 enterprise support for SLA breaches; escalation path included." Please send legal the exact wording.

legal-bot: Legal notified. Please allow 48 hours for review of SLA phrasing. Avoid absolute guarantees about "data never leaves" claims.

Omar (Eng): Bench notes: Hosted p95 ~120ms (single-region small models), Dedicated p95 ~70-90ms depending on instance type; token cost/1k varies by model and quantization. I'll export chart PNGs 1200x800 and include CSV. ETA: Mon EOD.

Nina (Field): Battle card highlights: common Qs -> encryption at rest/in-transit, KMS integration, audit logs, region options, can we do air-gapped? Short answer: yes for Private with on-prem package; refer to Private deployment brief.

Dana (Marketing): Sam, please include a 1-line webinar teaser for field comms. Keep it <120 chars and CTA-driven.

Sam (Growth): Teaser options: 
- "How enterprise teams get predictable LLM inference: security, SLAs, and deployment options — join our 30-min briefing."
- "LLM inference for regulated apps: cost, latency, and security tradeoffs. Wed webinar."

Jon (Design): I'll drop placeholders into the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/field-kit-designs. Please add final copy there.

Dana (Marketing): Routing rules (draft): default inbound -> SDR. If message includes keywords [private, on-prem, SOC2, HIPAA, SLA] -> auto-route to Enterprise AE + Field SE. Nina will own exceptions.

Nina (Field): Confirmed. Also flag leads that request proofs (pen-test reports, SOC2 artifacts) -> route to AE and Customer Security team.

Ivy (Product): One more note: include short "what we don't cover" section: model training data guarantees, customer-managed data deletion timeline exceptions. Keep legal happy.

Dana (Marketing): Nice. Timeline recap:
- SLA copy 1 Ivy 1 Mon noon
- Bench images 1 Omar 1 Mon EOD
- AE battle cards 1 Nina 1 Tue morning
- Design assets 1 Jon 1 Tue noon
- Legal review 1 legal-bot 1 Wed
- Ship to field 1 Tue EOD next week

Sam (Growth): Small ask: can we get 2 short social-friendly lines for field reps to paste into outreach? I'll draft once copy is locked.

Dana (Marketing): Great. If nobody objects I'll lock this plan and start building assets. Ping this thread with any copy edits. Thanks :sparkles:
